question: What attainment is promised to one who knows the ritual procedure within six months?
premises: The practitioner knows the prescribed ritual method.
A period of six months is specified.
Great Lakṣmī is the object attained.
inference: One who knows the procedure obtains great Lakṣmī within six months.
plain_english: One who knows the proper procedure obtains great Lakṣmī within six months.
